queries.shared_dependencies: SELECT payload,payload::text FROM (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('raw',to_jsonb(d),'object',to_jsonb(pg_identify_object(d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid)),'reference',to_jsonb(pg_identify_object(d.refclassid,d.refobjid,0))) ORDER BY d.dbid,d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid,d.refclassid,d.refobjid,d.deptype),'[]'::jsonb) AS payload FROM pg_shdepend d WHERE d.dbid=0 OR d.dbid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database())) AS capture
queries.shared_descriptions: SELECT payload,payload::text FROM (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('raw',to_jsonb(d),'identity',to_jsonb(pg_identify_object(d.classoid,d.objoid,0))) ORDER BY d.classoid,d.objoid),'[]'::jsonb) AS payload FROM pg_shdescription d WHERE d.classoid='pg_authid'::regclass OR (d.classoid='pg_database'::regclass AND d.objoid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()))) AS capture
queries.shared_security_labels: SELECT payload,payload::text FROM (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('raw',to_jsonb(d),'identity',to_jsonb(pg_identify_object(d.classoid,d.objoid,0))) ORDER BY d.classoid,d.objoid,d.provider),'[]'::jsonb) AS payload FROM pg_shseclabel d WHERE d.classoid='pg_authid'::regclass OR (d.classoid='pg_database'::regclass AND d.objoid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()))) AS capture
queries.triggers: SELECT payload,payload::text FROM (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('raw',to_jsonb(t),'identity',to_jsonb(pg_identify_object('pg_trigger'::regclass,t.oid,0)),'relation',to_jsonb(pg_identify_object('pg_class'::regclass,t.tgrelid,0)),'function',to_jsonb(pg_identify_object('pg_proc'::regclass,t.tgfoid,0)),'constraint',CASE WHEN t.tgconstraint<>0 THEN to_jsonb(pg_identify_object('pg_constraint'::regclass,t.tgconstraint,0)) END,'constraint_relation',CASE WHEN t.tgconstrrelid<>0 THEN to_jsonb(pg_identify_object('pg_class'::regclass,t.tgconstrrelid,0)) END,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,false)) ORDER BY t.oid),'[]'::jsonb) AS payload FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace UNION SELECT reltoastrelid FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND reltoastrelid<>0 UNION SELECT i.indexrelid FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.reltoastrelid=i.indrelid WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace)) AS capture
queries.types: SELECT payload,payload::text FROM (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('raw',to_jsonb(t),'identity',to_jsonb(pg_identify_object('pg_type'::regclass,t.oid,0)),'owner',pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner),'formatted_type',format_type(t.oid,NULL),'element',CASE WHEN t.typelem<>0 THEN to_jsonb(pg_identify_object('pg_type'::regclass,t.typelem,0)) END,'array',CASE WHEN t.typarray<>0 THEN to_jsonb(pg_identify_object('pg_type'::regclass,t.typarray,0)) END,'relation',CASE WHEN t.typrelid<>0 THEN to_jsonb(pg_identify_object('pg_class'::regclass,t.typrelid,0)) END,'base',CASE WHEN t.typbasetype<>0 THEN to_jsonb(pg_identify_object('pg_type'::regclass,t.typbasetype,0)) END,'default',pg_get_expr(t.typdefaultbin,0,false),'handlers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('field',h.field,'oid',h.oid,'rendered',h.oid::regproc::text,'identity',CASE WHEN h.oid<>0 THEN to_jsonb(pg_identify_object('pg_proc'::regclass,h.oid,0)) END) ORDER BY h.field) FROM (VALUES ('typinput',t.typinput::oid),('typoutput',t.typoutput::oid),('typreceive',t.typreceive::oid),('typsend',t.typsend::oid),('typmodin',t.typmodin::oid),('typmodout',t.typmodout::oid),('typanalyze',t.typanalyze::oid),('typsubscript',t.typsubscript::oid)) h(field,oid))) ORDER BY t.oid),'[]'::jsonb) AS payload FROM pg_type t WHERE t.typnamespace='public'::regnamespace OR t.typrelid IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace UNION SELECT reltoastrelid FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND reltoastrelid<>0 UNION SELECT i.indexrelid FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.reltoastrelid=i.indrelid WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace)) AS capture
queries.views: SELECT payload,payload::text FROM (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('raw',(to_jsonb(c)-ARRAY['relfilenode','relpages','reltuples','relallvisible','relfrozenxid','relminmxid']),'identity',to_jsonb(pg_identify_object('pg_class'::regclass,c.oid,0)),'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'definition',pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,false),'options',c.reloptions,'ACL',c.relacl) ORDER BY c.oid),'[]'::jsonb) AS payload FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND c.relkind IN ('v','m')) AS capture

sequence_state: SELECT payload,payload::text FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_object('last_value',last_value,'is_called',is_called) AS payload FROM {sequence}) AS capture
